label: SIMULATED
description: SIMULATED weekday morning on the pattern of 19 Aug 2025, when tracks went under water at Sion and Kurla (as reported). Central Railway locals stop between Dadar and Kurla and stranded commuters pour out of the stations onto the roads: the Dadar forecourts fill Tilak Bridge and Dr Ambedkar Road at Dadar TT, CSMT spills onto D N Road, Kurla onto LBS Marg and Andheri East onto the Andheri-Kurla Road. Share taxis and autos crowd the kerbs at Dadar TT and a BEST bus breaks down at King's Circle while extra BEST buses run a shuttle column from Dadar West to Sion. Commuter loads and timings are modelled assumptions; the AI proposes holds, BEST diversions and advisories, a named officer decides.
